name: ranniti
description: Ranniti root runner for backend and web

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,web" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web
